written.headline: Vultr launches 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs
written.summary: Vultr announced a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai, India, equipped with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs featuring 288 GB HBM3E memory per GPU. The deployment is the largest AMD Instinct installation in India and one of the world’s biggest.

written.headline: US unlikely to adopt major AI regulations as UBS predicts light‑touch approach
written.summary: A UBS report says the United States is unlikely to introduce significant AI regulations despite the issue’s prominence in the 2026 midterm elections. The report cites expectations that AI will add about 100 basis points to US growth in the first half of 2026 and that capex by hyperscalers could reach nearly 2% of GDP.

written.headline: India creates domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence
written.summary: BJP Lok Sabha member Kamaljeet Sehrawat said India has developed a domestic framework for evaluating the trustworthiness of AI in defence, built on reliability, safety and transparency. India also co‑sponsored the first UN informal exchange on AI in the military domain.
